sources_read: right-word holdout dev and test files (sentence IDs and right-word lemmas only)

definitions.normalisation: DCS_pick's three non-SLP1 vowel characters mapped (ṝ to F, ± to x, ² to X); whitespace runs collapsed to one space, ends stripped
definitions.not_slp1: any character other than SLP1 letters, avagraha and space remains: editorial markers, digits, unknown signs; removed from both corpora
definitions.exact_duplicate: normalised text equal to a held-out sentence
definitions.near_duplicate: shares at least 2 distinct 30-character substrings with any held-out sentence
definitions.held_lemma: DCS lemma annotation (IAST, converted to SLP1) includes a held-out right-word lemma; P-B only

plan_figures_2026-10-24.note: The near-duplicate method of 2026-10-24 was not recorded. Its 425 could not be reproduced on SLP1 or IAST text; the stated definition gives the count above, which removes more.
